2608.29478.title: Applications of Risk Science to AI Fairness Evaluation: Principles, Challenges, and Best Practices
2608.29478.paper_summary: Scholarly work which aims to describe potential societal impacts (e.g., risks) of proliferating technology (especially related to artificial intelligence or other algorithmic systems) is likely to have an impact beyond the scientific communities it was written for, given that general society itself is a primary object of study. However, it is an open question whether the current practices of AI evaluation scholarship follow the principles and best practices established by risk science, which aims to systematically generate knowledge related to understanding, assessing, communicating, managing, and governing risk. In this work, we examine this in depth by conducting a literature review of scholarly works purporting to evaluate the bias or fairness of technological systems used for tasks related to hiring and employment. Through analysis of 22 common fairness evaluation metrics and studies using them, we find that most characterize the severity of bias- or fairness-related consequences but do not follow best practices to characterize the uncertainty around either the occurrence of these consequences or severity estimates. Next, we conduct a case study of fairness evaluation for an AI-mediated resume screening task and demonstrate how principles of risk science can be incorporated into such an evaluation. Finally, we propose the AI Risk Report Card, which facilitates the reporting and communication of risk assessment results to stakeholders in positions to act based on the predicted risks. The outcomes of these activities suggest that further research at the convergence of risk science and AI evaluation can lead to advancements in AI assessments of societal impact by enabling shared frameworks to evaluate and discuss AI risks both within and outside of the scientific community.
2608.29478.paper_summary_zh: 學術工作旨在描述技術擴散（特別是與人工智慧或其他算法系統相關）可能對社會造成的影響（例如風險），其影響可能超出其所針對的科學社群，因為整體社會本身就是主要的研究對象。 然而，目前的人工智慧評估學術實踐是否遵循風險科學所建立的原則和最佳實踐仍然是一個未解的問題，風險科學旨在系統性地產生與理解、評估、傳達、管理和治理風險相關的知識。 在這項工作中，我們通過對聲稱評估與招聘和就業相關的技術系統的偏見或公平性的學術作品進行文獻回顧，深入研究這一問題。 通過分析22個常見的公平性評估指標及其使用的研究，我們發現大多數指標描述了與偏見或公平性相關後果的嚴重性，但未遵循最佳實踐來描述這些後果的發生或嚴重性估計的不確定性。 接下來，我們對一個人工智慧中介的簡歷篩選任務進行了公平性評估的案例研究，並展示了如何將風險科學的原則納入這種評估中。 最後，我們提出了人工智慧風險報告卡，該報告卡促進了向能夠根據預測風險採取行動的利益相關者報告和傳達風險評估結果。 這些活動的結果表明，在風險科學與人工智慧評估的交匯處進行進一步研究，可以通過促進共享框架來評估和討論人工智慧風險，從而推動人工智慧對社會影響的評估進展，無論是在科學社群內部還是外部。
